# A09-S167: Culture programme

Extract from the municipality’s public press announcement. Public event credit is retained; the private forwarding chain is omitted.

[…]

Dear local press,

Vestegnen's Culture Week offers in week 37 a series of fine events in Høje-Taastrup Municipality, created by local cultural actors etc.

The "flagship" is, following previous years' great audience successes, the fantastic large sound and light show, which this year has moved to Selsmosen and takes place three evenings on 15.-17. September at 20.30 o'clock. Båll & Brand are behind the show "The Ice is Melting at the Pøules," which with 20 lasers, light cannons, projections, poetry, musicians, singers and an electronic composition by the Lithuanian composer and art professor Jonas Jurkunas and his electronic universe Robotic Folk focus on the large temperature increases and climate changes.

But the culture week's programme begins already Friday the 9 September with a – sold out! – guided tour in the Learning House in Nærheden. Instead, you can still manage to experience a bit of both the Learning House and Nærheden by buying a ticket for an evening event Tuesday the 13 September. The event offers a mini-city walk in Nærheden and information about the thoughts behind the creation of the new district, and actor Henrik Prip from Mungo Park performs the newly created Vestegns poem "Today – in the future." Finally, there is food and music, all in the Learning House.

Saturday and Sunday the 10 and 11 September, MindFuture Foundation invites to an event at Erik Husfeldts Vej where they have invited "digital artist Andreas Refsgaard and our party secretary Computer Lars to facilitate a space where you can meet The Synthetic Party through chatbots, and learn to use the technology in a democratic sense," as they write. If you then need something about "the old days," Kroppedal Museum offers on 11 September historic games for the whole family.

Sunday the 11 there is also an accordion concert with the large accordion orchestra Tutti in Hedehuset. More music is for example when the music schools in Høje-Taastrup and several neighboring municipalities Friday the 16 September in Taastrup Theater & Music House offer a concert with electronic music, performed by the 13-25-year-old students. The same evening there is a concert with Mehmet Atli Trio in Taastrup Culture Center. Find more concerts and invitation to try lanciers etc. in the programme.

There are several exhibitions in culture week, and there is the opportunity to visit the artist project Sisters Hope Home in Hedehusene Tuesday the 13 September. In Taastrup you are invited on two artistic city walks with City Matters Saturday the 17 September, where participants via headphones experience a sound universe during the walk, which also offers artistic scenes. The walks start in the Community House and end with a chat with the artists over a glass of bubbles and snacks in Taastrup Theater & Music House.

Find the above and many more events via the joint website www.vkir.dk<http://www.vkir.dk> and in the event calendar in the municipality's app OplevHTK. In addition, the Cultural Council has ensured that a printed folder with an overview of the local events has been published – you can, for example, get it at the libraries, culture houses, and Taastrup Theater & Music House.

PDF of the programme is attached.
